author: EmuCore - Hub
title: DuckStation can populate a whole library's missing achievement icons at once
summary: A batch RetroAchievements query and progress dialog replace the old launch-each-game workflow, downloading only icons absent from the local cache.
heroAlt: Visual evidence from DuckStation pull request #3655: GameList: Add option to download all game icons

sourceLabels.duckstation-pr-3655: GameList: Add option to download all game icons

blocks.text: The automatic icon path only helped games after their first launch

DuckStation already downloaded a RetroAchievements badge when a game was opened and cached it for later Game List display. In a large collection, that meant most entries remained without icons until the user launched them one by one. The missing artwork was not a scanning failure; the network lookup lived in a lifecycle that many library entries had never reached.
One title query supplies the batch with achievement badge metadata

Pull request #3655 adds Achievements::DownloadGameIcons(). It uses rc_api_fetch_game_titles to request title and badge information for library games that have achievement data, then downloads images that are not already cached. Working from one batch of metadata avoids opening an emulation session per title, and the missing-only rule keeps a refresh from redownloading a complete icon library.
The Game List reports progress instead of freezing during network work

A new View-menu action starts the operation and displays a progress bar as icons arrive. Integrating the command through the Game List and main window keeps the result visible where users expect it. The existing refresh-achievement workflow provided related infrastructure, but the icon action is separately named so users do not have to infer that progress refresh also downloads artwork.
Large, partial, and offline libraries define the test matrix

Validation should use a library containing cached icons, missing icons, games without achievement data, regional duplicates, and an invalid or unavailable network response. Confirm that only eligible missing files are written, progress reaches completion, cancellation or shutdown leaves no corrupt partial image, and restarting skips completed downloads. Rate-limit and authentication errors should be surfaced without removing existing icons. Finally, reopen the Game List and verify every new cache entry resolves to the correct title.
The operation is intentionally incremental: fetch metadata in bulk, download only what the cache lacks, and keep network progress visible.
